summary: The customer called to request a payment extension on his utility bill because he was unable to pay the full amount due in two days. The agent verified his account, offered a 14-day extension at no extra fee, processed it successfully, and sent a text confirmation.

evidence.text: I am processing that extension for you right now.
evidence.speaker: Agent

commitments.description: Process a 14-day payment extension for the current balance.

evidence.text: The text should arrive in just a moment.
evidence.speaker: Agent

commitments.description: Send a text message containing the confirmation details.

evidence.text: I completely understand that getting a high bill can be stressful, and I'd be happy to look into some options for you today.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent was polite, professional, and maintained a helpful demeanor throughout the call.

evidence.text: I can offer you a standard extension of fourteen days from your current due date.
